title: No Alarm sounds / Redmi Note 4
symptom: Alarms set up in xDrip+ only two (high sugar / low sugar) work with tone, others work without sound; information appears and phone vibrates but no sound, even though phone is not muted and various alarm sounds tried.
fix: Go to Settings --> App Management (or similar) --> xDrip+ --> Notifications (or similar) --> Allow sound.
evidence_quote: I solved the problem. Settings --> App Management (or similar i have polish menu) -->xDrip+ --> Notifications (or similar) --> Allow sound.
